channel.title: High End Fire Collectables — Sealed Product
channel.description: Sealed Pokemon TCG product in stock in Australia. Prices in AUD.

item.g:title: Pokemon Mega Evolution Ascended Heroes Booster Bundle
item.g:description: Factory sealed Booster Bundle from Pokemon TCG: Mega Evolution — Ascended Heroes. Six sealed booster packs, each with 10 cards plus a Basic Energy and a Pokemon TCG Live code card. The set headlined by Mega Dragonite ex, with Mega Lucario ex and Mega Charizard X in the chase.

item.g:title: Mewtwo #12/113 Holo EX Delta Species
item.g:description: Mewtwo holographic #12/113 from the 2005 Pokemon TCG EX Delta Species expansion. The Delta Switch / Energy Burst Mewtwo, one of the most recognisable holos of the EX era. Ungraded copy — we also stock this card slabbed.

item.g:title: 1999 Base Set Machamp Holo #8/102 1st Edition
item.g:description: Machamp holographic #8/102 from the 1999 Pokemon Base Set, carrying the 1st Edition stamp. Base Set Machamp shipped inside the 2-Player Starter Set, which makes it the one 1st Edition Base Set holo most collectors can actually get their hands on.

item.g:title: 1999 Base Set Gyarados Holo #6/102
item.g:description: Gyarados holographic #6/102 from the 1999 Pokemon Base Set. Mitsuhiro Arita's rampaging Gyarados, one of the original sixteen Base Set holos and a cornerstone WOTC card.

item.g:title: 1999 Base Set Magneton Holo #9/102
item.g:description: Magneton holographic #9/102 from the 1999 Pokemon Base Set, illustrated by Keiji Kinebuchi. One of the original sixteen Base Set holos.

item.g:title: Alakazam ex #201/165 Special Illustration Rare 151
item.g:description: Alakazam ex #201/165 Special Illustration Rare from Pokemon TCG: Scarlet & Violet 151. Shinya Komatsu paints Alakazam mid-study surrounded by books and apparatus — one of the most chased SIRs in the whole 151 set.

item.g:title: 1999 Jungle Vaporeon Holo #12/64
item.g:description: Vaporeon holographic #12/64 from the 1999 Pokemon Jungle expansion, illustrated by Kagemaru Himeno. First-generation Eeveelution holo from the first ever Pokemon expansion set.

item.g:title: 1999 Jungle Nidoqueen Holo #7/64
item.g:description: Nidoqueen holographic #7/64 from the 1999 Pokemon Jungle expansion, illustrated by Ken Sugimori. Vintage WOTC holo with the much-loved Boyfriends attack.

item.g:title: Fuecoco #201/193 Illustration Rare Paldea Evolved
item.g:description: Fuecoco #201/193 Illustration Rare from Pokemon TCG: Paldea Evolved. kantaro's supermarket scene — Fuecoco perched in a trolley full of groceries — and easily one of the best-loved IRs of the Scarlet & Violet era.

item.g:title: Skeledirge ex #258/193 Special Illustration Rare Paldea Evolved
item.g:description: Skeledirge ex #258/193 Special Illustration Rare from Pokemon TCG: Paldea Evolved. kantaro's street-corner performance scene and the headline chase card of the set.

item.g:title: Charizard VMAX #SWSH261 Black Star Promo
item.g:description: Charizard VMAX #SWSH261 Black Star Promo, exclusive to the Sword & Shield Charizard Ultra-Premium Collection. Shiburingaru's full-art G-Max Wildfire Charizard, only ever available inside the UPC box.

item.g:title: Charizard VSTAR #SWSH262 Black Star Promo
item.g:description: Charizard VSTAR #SWSH262 Black Star Promo from the Sword & Shield Charizard Ultra-Premium Collection. Kiyotaka Oshiyama's alternate-art VSTAR bursting through the flames — the companion card to the SWSH261 VMAX.

item.g:title: 1999 Base Set Mewtwo Holo #10/102
item.g:description: Mewtwo holographic #10/102 from the 1999 Pokemon Base Set, illustrated by Ken Sugimori. The original Base Set Mewtwo holo, Psychic and Barrier.

item.g:title: Mewtwo & Mew GX #052/173 Japanese SM12a Tag All Stars
item.g:description: Mewtwo & Mew GX #052/173 RR from the Japanese SM12a Tag All Stars set. Mitsuhiro Arita TAG TEAM artwork with the Miracle Twin GX attack, Japanese print.

item.g:title: Moltres & Zapdos & Articuno GX #44/68 Hidden Fates
item.g:description: Moltres & Zapdos & Articuno GX #44/68 from Pokemon TCG: Hidden Fates. Mitsuhiro Arita's legendary-bird TAG TEAM with the Sky Legends GX attack, from one of the most collected modern sets.

item.g:title: Rayquaza VMAX #TG20/TG30 Silver Tempest Trainer Gallery
item.g:description: Rayquaza VMAX #TG20/TG30 from the Silver Tempest Trainer Gallery. Hideki Ishikawa's Trainer Gallery treatment of the Rapid Strike Rayquaza VMAX, 320 HP with Azure Pulse.

item.g:title: Gengar & Mimikyu GX #53/181 Team Up
item.g:description: Gengar & Mimikyu GX #53/181 from Pokemon TCG: Team Up. Mitsuhiro Arita TAG TEAM art with the Horror House GX hand-lock that defined a format.

item.g:title: Piplup #052/049 CHR Japanese SM11b Dream League
item.g:description: Piplup #052/049 Character Rare from the Japanese SM11b Dream League set. Tomomi Kaneko pairs Piplup with Dawn in one of the most collected CHRs of the Sun & Moon run.

item.g:title: Pikachu VMAX #TG17/TG30 Lost Origin Trainer Gallery
item.g:description: Pikachu VMAX #TG17/TG30 from the Lost Origin Trainer Gallery. Souichirou Gunjima's Trainer Gallery Pikachu VMAX, 310 HP with G-Max Volt Tackle.

item.g:title: Seismitoad #105/086 Illustration Rare Black Bolt
item.g:description: Seismitoad #105/086 Illustration Rare from Pokemon TCG: Black Bolt. Shinji Kanda's densely patterned artwork, one of the standout IRs of the 2025 set.

item.g:title: 2000 Team Rocket Dark Charmeleon #32/82 Stamped
item.g:description: Dark Charmeleon #32/82 from the 2000 Pokemon Team Rocket expansion — a stamped copy. Kagemaru Himeno artwork, from the set that introduced the Dark Pokemon mechanic to the TCG.

item.g:title: Pokemon Mega Evolution Pitch Black Sealed Booster Box
item.g:description: Factory sealed 36-pack booster display from Pokemon TCG: Mega Evolution — Pitch Black. 36 packs × 10 cards, still in the original shrink. The set headlined by Mega Darkrai ex and Mega Zeraora ex, with 115+ cards to chase.

item.g:title: Pokemon Mega Evolution Pitch Black Elite Trainer Box
item.g:description: Factory sealed Elite Trainer Box from Mega Evolution — Pitch Black. Includes 9 booster packs, a full-art foil Zarude promo, 65 card sleeves, 45 Energy cards, a player's guide, 6 damage-counter dice, a competition-legal flip die, and a collector's box with 6 dividers.

item.g:title: Pokemon Mega Evolution Pitch Black Booster Bundle
item.g:description: Factory sealed Booster Bundle from Mega Evolution — Pitch Black. Six sealed booster packs, each with 10 cards plus a Basic Energy and a Pokemon TCG Live code card. The easiest way into the Mega Darkrai ex set.

item.g:title: Pokemon Mega Evolution Chaos Rising Booster Bundle
item.g:description: Factory sealed Booster Bundle from Mega Evolution — Chaos Rising (ME04). Six sealed booster packs, each with 10 cards plus a Basic Energy and a Pokemon TCG Live code card. Over 120 cards in the set, headlined by Mega Floette ex and Mega Dragalge ex.

item.g:title: Pokemon SV10 Destined Rivals Sealed Booster Box
item.g:description: Factory sealed Scarlet & Violet Destined Rivals (SV10) booster box — 36 packs, case-fresh and unsearched. The Team Rocket expansion, headlined by Team Rocket's Mewtwo ex and Cynthia's Garchomp ex. These were opened from a sealed manufacturer's case, so every box is untouched and unweighed. Six available. The photo shows the sealed case they came out of, not the individual box — you receive one sealed booster box.

item.g:title: 1999 Fossil Lapras Holo #10/62 1st Edition PSA 7
item.g:description: Lapras holographic #10/62 from the 1999 Pokemon Fossil expansion, 1st Edition. Graded PSA 7 Near Mint (cert 106517347). Vintage WOTC holo with the coveted 1st Edition stamp.

item.g:title: Mega Greninja ex #122/086 Gold Hyper Rare
item.g:description: Mega Greninja ex #122/086 full-gold Hyper Rare from the Mega Evolution era. Near Mint, raw and ungraded — a strong PSA candidate and a standout modern chase card.

item.g:title: Dragonite No.149 Japanese GB Game Boy Promo
item.g:description: Dragonite (カイリュー) No.149 from the Japanese Pokemon Card GB (Game Boy) promo set. Classic Old Back vintage Japanese card. Lightly Played — a nostalgic collector favourite.

item.g:title: Golduck #177/S-P Simplified Chinese Gym Promo
item.g:description: Golduck (哥达鸭) #177/S-P from the Simplified Chinese Pokemon TCG Gym promo series. Near Mint. An affordable, distinctive promo for the discerning collector.

item.g:title: Mew ex #232 Pokemon Paldean Fates
item.g:description: Mew ex #232 full art from Pokemon Paldean Fates. Pack fresh mint condition. One of the most valuable modern Pokemon cards. PSA 10 candidate.

item.g:title: Lillie's Determination SAR 091/063 Mega Brave
item.g:description: Japanese Special Art Rare (SAR) from Mega Brave. Lillie's Determination 091/063. Mint condition full art trainer. Highly collectible Japanese exclusive.

item.g:title: Team Rocket's Mewtwo ex #125 Glory of Team Rocket
item.g:description: Team Rocket's Mewtwo ex #125 from Glory of Team Rocket — a Japanese-exclusive set never released in English. Mint condition. Limited regional distribution; no English equivalent exists.

item.g:title: Team Rocket's Mewtwo ex 240/182 Destined Rivals
item.g:description: Team Rocket's Mewtwo ex 240/182 secret rare alternate art from Destined Rivals. Mint condition. One of the hottest pulls from 2025's biggest Pokemon set.

item.g:title: Poliwrath 109/128 1st Edition Holo Rare E Series Japanese
item.g:description: Poliwrath 109/128 first edition holo rare from the Japanese E Series expansion. Near Mint to Lightly Played. A scarce 1st edition stamp from the early 2000s Japanese E Series — increasingly hard to find in this condition.

item.g:title: Starmie V (CSR) 083/067 S9a Battle Region
item.g:description: Starmie V Character Super Rare 083/067 from S9a Battle Region — a Japanese exclusive set. Near Mint. One of the most beloved CSRs from the Battle Region set, featuring a stunning underwater illustration.

item.g:title: Team Rocket's Moltres ex SAR 124/098
item.g:description: Team Rocket's Moltres ex Special Art Rare 124/098. Near Mint. A stunning SAR with a dramatic full-art illustration — one of the most visually striking cards from the Glory of Team Rocket set.

item.g:title: Machoke 177/165 Illustration Rare 151
item.g:description: Machoke 177/165 Illustration Rare from the Pokemon 151 set. Near Mint. A fan-favourite IR with a beautifully detailed full-art illustration — one of the standout pulls from the 151 set.

item.g:title: Dark Feraligatr #160 Neo Destiny Japanese
item.g:description: Dark Feraligatr #160 from the Japanese Neo Destiny expansion. Near Mint. A fan-favourite Dark Pokémon from one of the most beloved sets in the Neo era — tough to find in this condition.

item.g:title: Mew EX 024/020 Holo Shiny Collection Japanese Secret Rare
item.g:description: Mew EX 024/020 holo secret rare from the Japanese Shiny Collection — a Japanese exclusive set never released in English. Lightly Played. One of the most coveted Mew cards from the BW era.

item.g:title: Mega Dragonite ex 271/217 Ascended Heroes
item.g:description: Mega Dragonite ex 271/217 secret rare from the Ascended Heroes set. Near Mint. A stunning illustration secret rare featuring one of Pokemon's most beloved Dragon-types.

item.g:title: Mewtwo Holo Delta Species PSA 9
item.g:description: Mewtwo holographic from the 2005 Pokemon TCG EX Delta Species set, graded PSA 9 Mint. One of the most recognisable Mewtwo holo cards from the EX era — slabbed and investment-grade.

item.g:title: Gengar No.094 1997 Mystery of the Fossils Old Back — Japanese Pokemon Card
item.g:description: Gengar No.094 from the 1997 Japanese Mystery of the Fossils expansion with the iconic Old Back. Near Mint to Lightly Played. A rare piece of vintage WOTC-era Japanese history.

item.g:title: Mew GG10/GG70 Crown Zenith Galarian Gallery
item.g:description: Mew GG10/GG70 from the Crown Zenith Galarian Gallery subset. Near Mint. One of the most iconic Mew cards in the modern era — a fan favourite full-art illustration.

item.g:title: Pikachu 323/S-P Precious Collector Box Japanese Promo
item.g:description: Pikachu 323/S-P exclusive Japanese promo from the Precious Collector Box. Near Mint condition. A highly sought-after promo only obtainable from this limited box set.

item.g:title: Energy Marker E-78 Dragon Ball Super Card Game Fusion World
item.g:description: Energy Marker E-78 from Dragon Ball Super Card Game Fusion World, English print. Foil manga-art marker featuring Goku — the token card every Fusion World deck runs, in its premium foil treatment.

item.g:title: Frieza SB02-054 SR Dragon Ball Super Card Game Fusion World
item.g:description: Frieza SB02-054 Super Rare from Dragon Ball Super Card Game Fusion World. Full-foil Frieza Clan / Frieza's Army leader art with the 20,000 power hit.

item.g:title: Son Gohan Youth FB03-139 SCR Alternative Art Raging Roar Fusion World
item.g:description: Son Gohan Youth FB03-139 Secret Rare Alternative Art from Dragon Ball Fusion World Raging Roar. Near Mint. One of the most sought-after SCR alt arts from the FB03 set — a must-have for Gohan collectors.

item.g:title: Raditz SB01-026 SR Alternate Art Dragon Ball Fusion World
item.g:description: Raditz SB01-026 Secret Rare Alternate Art from Dragon Ball Fusion World — English edition. Near Mint. A striking alt art featuring one of Dragon Ball's most iconic villains, from the SB01 starter set.

item.g:title: Son Goku GT FB07-122 Secret Rare Wish For Shenron Dragon Ball Fusion World
item.g:description: Son Goku GT FB07-122 Secret Rare from Dragon Ball Fusion World Wish For Shenron. Near Mint. A stunning SR featuring GT Goku from the FB07 set.

item.g:title: 2024 One Piece Nami #007 OP06 Treasure Rare PSA 10
item.g:description: Nami #007 Treasure Rare from One Piece Card Game OP06, graded PSA 10 Gem Mint (cert 89262433). Treasure Rare Nami is the standout chase card of the set and a genuinely tough grade to hit.
